name: Innkeeper Renee
summary: Innkeeper Renee runs the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, offering shelter, food, and drink to the Forsaken and to Horde travelers passing through Tirisfal Glades.

sections.title: Keeper of Gallows' End
sections.body: Renee keeps the Gallows' End Tavern, the inn at the heart of Brill. Behind her counter she sells food, drink and general goods, and she welcomes weary newcomers to rest their bones, remarking that the Forsaken certainly do have huge appetites. For the undead of Tirisfal, her tavern is a cozy little place where victims of the plague try to make their way in the world.

sections.title: Letters and Captives
sections.body: Renee's inn is often a newcomer's first stop in Brill. Calvin Montague of Deathknell sends fresh adventurers to her with a nondescript letter, word she has been eagerly waiting for. Below her floorboards, the tavern's cellar also holds a captured Scarlet Crusade zealot.

aliases: who is the innkeeper in brill
faq.answer: Innkeeper Renee is the Forsaken innkeeper of the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. She sells food, drink, and general supplies to travelers across Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What is Renee's connection to Calvin Montague?
faq.answer: In the task 'A Rogue's Deal', adventurers running errands for Calvin Montague are sent to deliver a letter directly to Renee at the Gallows' End Tavern.

angles.text: Renee's tavern keeps up one of the old comforts of the living for the Forsaken of Tirisfal: a hearth, a meal and a place to rest.
